reviews.title: Restarts
reviews.text: This is the only app that forces me to restart when I’m in the middle of searching for something because there’s some dumb update. Just let me use the app, bro.

reviews.title: Glitchy App
reviews.text:
Let me start off by saying I love this app and normally I’d give it 5 stars.

In the current version there is a glitch with the keyboard that makes the app almost impossible to use. I’ll go to type, and then suddenly the keyboard will disappear not allowing me to fully type what I wanted to type. 

Considering this app is a guide and you need to type things to look things up, I’m going to rate this two stars until it gets fixed.

reviews.title: TERRIBLE CONTACT SUPPORT
reviews.text: Unwilling to help recover an account for a long time user. SHAMEFUL.

reviews.title: Off-line field guide
reviews.text: After updates it keeps making me redownload off-line field guide. You only notice this while off-line. Making the app useless till you get service again. It has now happened 3x to me.

reviews.title: Horrible app
reviews.text: Keep getting a "invalid field guide endpoint response" error when I want to download offline content. Why bother having this feature if it's never going to work? Deleting this app and my account. And they want a donation??? Seriously? They can't even get their app to work properly and they want a donation. Yeah, no.

reviews.title: Erased years of data
reviews.text: I've been using this app for years with no trouble. I recently opened it and all my information was gone. Years of sightings except my locations was gone! I wrote tech support for help and got some nonsense, unhelpful answer that "yeah a glitch has been happening". DON'T TRUST THIS APP!

reviews.title: What a joke
reviews.text: I see a dove I don’t know what kinda of dove it is so I try to identify it and this stupid app asks is it the size of a robin or a crow well it’s bigger the a robin but smaller then a crow

reviews.title: Run away!!!
reviews.text:
Had this app for years.  Never used the tracking.  I used this simply for identification.  At one point some years ago, it quit working.
Out of the blue it started working again.
Now after years of having and using this app, it wants me to log in and agree to receive communications.  
Frankly, I’m deleting this app!  
There are better apps that won’t force tracking!
